title: {name} Visits the Moon
cliffhanger: What did {name} find on the moon?

default_state.text: Hold on tight, {costar}! The moon is smiling at us!

script: One night, {name} and {costar} looked up. The moon was waving!
"Let's go!" said {name}, and {costar} flapped hard.
Up past the clouds they flew, faster than a shooting star.
The moon had craters like giant cups of cocoa.
"Hold on tight, {costar}! The moon is smiling at us!"
Behind a moon rock, something tiny was glowing…

title: {name} Under the Sea
cliffhanger: Who was singing in the deep blue sea?

default_state.text: Bubbles, bubbles everywhere! Hello, little fish!

script: {name} took a deep breath and dived into the sparkly sea.
{costar} blew bubbles shaped like stars.
A friendly whale swam by, humming a slow song.
"Bubbles, bubbles everywhere! Hello, little fish!"
Far below, a shell was humming back…

title: {name} in Dino Jungle

default_state.text: Stomp, stomp! A baby dino wants to play!

script: Deep in the jungle, {name} heard a tiny stomp.
{costar} peeked behind a big green leaf.
A baby dino giggled and splashed in the waterfall.
"Stomp, stomp! A baby dino wants to play!"
Then the ground went BOOM… and BOOM again.

title: {name}'s Birthday Party
cliffhanger: What was inside the biggest present?

default_state.text: Make a wish, {name}! Then blow really hard!

script: Balloons floated up as {name} came downstairs.
{costar} had baked a cake (a little wobbly).
Everyone sang, and the candles twinkled.
"Make a wish, {name}! Then blow really hard!"
In the corner sat one giant present, wiggling…

title: Goodnight, Stars
cliffhanger: Which star will {name} wish on tonight?

default_state.text: One star, two stars… sleepy stars, goodnight.

script: When the sky turned purple, {name} and {costar} counted stars.
Every star gave a tiny, sleepy twinkle.
"One star, two stars… sleepy stars, goodnight."
{costar} tucked in tiny wings and yawned.
Goodnight, {name}. Sweet dreams.

title: Cloud Whale Lullaby
cliffhanger: Where will the cloud whale float next?

default_state.text: Breathe in slow… breathe out slow… float like a cloud.

script: A whale made of clouds drifted past {name}'s window.
"Hop on," it whispered. {costar} climbed on too.
"Breathe in slow… breathe out slow… float like a cloud."
They floated over sleepy hills and quiet seas.
Back in bed, {name} smiled. Goodnight.
